name: Bethany

related_people.name: Lazarus
related_people.role: raised by Jesus here after four days in the tomb

related_people.name: Martha
related_people.role: welcomed Jesus into her home here and confessed Him at Lazarus's tomb

related_people.name: Mary
related_people.role: sat at Jesus's feet here and anointed them with costly perfume

description: A village near Jerusalem, home to the siblings Martha, Mary, and Lazarus, whom Jesus loved and regularly visited (Luke 10:38-42; John 11:1-5). It was in Bethany that Jesus raised Lazarus from the dead after four days in the tomb (John 11:1-44), and where He often stayed during His final week in Jerusalem.
